decision.summary: The approved SPEC's reachable set is confirmed: PNG, JPEG and WebP. Defaults: JPEG quality 90 and WebP quality 90 follow ShareX TaskSettings.cs (ImageJPEGQuality = 90, ImageWebPQuality = 90) and GIMP's JPEG export default (plug-ins/file-jpeg/jpeg.c, quality 0.9); the JPEG transparent-pixel background default is white (#FFFFFF) following ShareX's flatten path (TaskHelpers.cs, FillBackground(Color.White)). The values prefill the Save As fields and stay user-overridable; they are not silently sticky settings.
deferred: WebP lossless exposure: v1 Save As offers quality-controlled lossy WebP only, as this record's webp row already states; a lossless control is a recorded follow-up, not a v1 requirement.
Export color-profile/metadata policy: outside this record's fields; deferred unchanged with the EO-014 profile work.
